prompt:
Bug report: with the `toc` extension, a heading like `# Hello world !` gets the id `hello-world-`, with a trailing dash. Fix it and add a regression test.

Work on your own; nobody will answer questions. When you finish, report: status `done` if you did the task, `not_found` if something the task names does not exist, `blocked` if you could not do it; `answer` holds any answer the task asks for (otherwise one short sentence); `changed` lists the files you changed.

report.answer: I fixed the trailing dash: `# Hello world !` now gets the id `hello-world`. The cause was that `slugify` in the `toc` extension deleted the `!` but kept the space before it, and that space became a dash. It now strips leading and trailing whitespace after removing punctuation. I added three regression tests (trailing punctuation, leading punctuation, and the Unicode slugify) and checked that all three fail without the fix. With the fix, the full test suite passes (1132 tests, 112 skipped). I also added a changelog entry under a new [unreleased] heading.
